newsitem.title: USA: Catellus sees variability of qtly, annual income.
newsitem.headline: Catellus sees variability of qtly, annual income.

text.p: Catellus Development Corp said on Thursday that it expects the variability of its quarterly and annual net income to continue.

The company said in a press release that the timing of development sales and non-strategic asset sales has resulted in significant variability in its historic operating results, particularly on a quarterly basis.
Catellus reported net income of $5,685,000, down from $8,817,000 a year earlier, for the second quarter. The 1996 net was before $5,953,000 in preferred stock dividends.

The company explained that many of its projects require a lengthy process to complete the development cycle before they are sold and non-strategic asset sales are generally subject to lengthy negotiations and contingencies that need to be resolved prior to closing.
The company said that these factors tend to "bunch" income in particular periods rather than provide a more even pattern throughout a year.

The company added that gross margins vary significantly as the mix of properties varies. The cost basis of the properties sold varies because some have been owned for many decades, others were acquired within the last 10 to 15 years and still others are owned in various geographical locations.
Catellus is a real estate development and management company.
